payload.unit_title: M1.1 Completed — Supervisor Next Migration Action Decision
payload.objective: Inspect the migration control-plane context and determine the correct next task and decomposition following M1.1 completion.
payload.explicit_request: M1.1 is COMPLETED. Determine the next migration action. Do not assume that the next action is simply 'implement M1.2'. Inspect the migration control-plane context and determine the correct next task and decomposition. Return either TASK_DISPATCH, ESCALATE, or ABORT.

payload.reason: M1.1 is fully completed and there is no M1.2 defined in the authoritative control plane. The next action must therefore be selected from the currently eligible NOT_STARTED units whose dependencies are satisfied. M2.1 is eligible because its sole dependency, M1.1, is COMPLETED. It is the first unit in the R21 Major Project critical-path chain (M2.1 -> M2.2 -> M2.3 -> M7.1) and its scope is explicitly defined as the R21 Major Project backend/controller layer. The correct next action is not implementation yet: according to the Supervisor protocol, an eligible NOT_STARTED unit must first enter ANALYZING and undergo Scanner/Architect discovery. The worker must inspect the legacy implementation, target state, routes, models, views, and existing CampusLynk conventions, then return a TASK_REPORT from which the implementation specification can be derived and reviewed.

task_dispatch.objective: Perform a read-only architectural and migration-scope analysis of the R21 Major Project Backend Controller and Evaluation Endpoints unit and determine the exact first implementation slice.
instructions: Inspect the authoritative migration control-plane information for M2.1.
Inspect the corresponding legacy R21 Major Project controller, routes, models, views, print/report dependencies, and related database usage required to establish the backend scope.
Inspect the existing CampusLynk target architecture and conventions relevant to controller, validation, authorization, routing, models, responses, and testing.
Identify the concrete controller methods, endpoints, models, routes, and supporting changes required for M2.1.
Identify any hidden coupling with M4.1 AttendanceController or other migration units and explicitly report it.
Do NOT modify any application files, migrations, models, routes, views, tests, or database.
Do NOT execute migrations or destructive database operations.
constraints: DO NOT modify docs/migration control-plane files.
Do not expand scope into M2.2 frontend workspace implementation or M2.3 print-report implementation.
Do not modify app/Models/User.php unless a dependency is discovered; if discovered, report it rather than changing it.
task_dispatch.expected_report: Complete M2.1 scope definition; legacy files and target files discovered; controller methods and routes required; model/schema dependencies; legacy-to-target differences; authorization and validation requirements; testing requirements; hidden dependencies or ambiguities; proposed allowed_files whitelist; proposed acceptance criteria; recommended implementation decomposition and first concrete implementation task.
stop_conditions: Stop after producing the read-only TASK_REPORT.
